events.title: In association football , FC 바이에른 뮌헨 become the first team to score eight goals in a UEFA Champions League knockout match after doing so against 바르셀로나 in a quarter-finals match that ended 8–2. 바르셀로나 suffer one of their worst defeats in history, having conceded eight goals for the first time since 1946. (AP via Philippine Daily Inquirer )
In association football , 세비야 defeat 인테르 3–2 in the final to win the UEFA Europa League for a record sixth time. (AP via Lincoln Journal Star )

Rioting erupts in 파리 FC following the defeat of 파리 생제르맹 F.C. in the Champions League final . Riot police fire tear gas at groups of PSG fans, who responded by throwing fireworks and flares. Several arrests are made. ( The Mirror )

In association football , FC 바이에른 뮌헨 defeat French opponents 파리 생제르맹 F.C. 1–0 at the Estádio da Luz , Lisbon , to win their sixth Champions League title and second continental treble . 바이에른 뮌헨 become the first team to win any European competition with a 100% winning record . (BBC Sport)
